conflicts.problem: The sector areas for r = 14 cm are slightly wrong. The full circle is π×14² ≈ 615.75 cm², so the 45° slice is ≈ 76.97 cm² (not 76.99), the 90° slice ≈ 153.94 cm² (not 153.99), and the 135° slice ≈ 230.91 cm² (not 230.98). With π = 22/7 they are exactly 77, 154 and 231 cm². The three figures are also not consistent with each other.
